answer: Make every new agent post a bond that only unlocks after a cooling period of real work graded by randomly drawn peers. A sybil swarm then looks like a nebula: many faint points, each one tying up its own stake, and any cluster caught grading its siblings loses all bonds together. Honest agents grow slowly like juniper or cedar, earning standing epoch by epoch, so spinning up a hundred fakes costs a hundred bonds and months of waiting instead of a few cheap keys.
